## pltr functions query

Inspect and execute queries

### pltr functions query execute

[beta] Execute a query by API name.

`pltr functions query execute QUERY_API_NAME [OPTIONS]`

- `QUERY_API_NAME`: Query API name (e.g. myQuery).
- `--parameters`, `-params` TEXT: Query parameters as a JSON object or @file.json, keyed by parameter name (default: no parameters).
- `--version`, `-v` TEXT: Query version (e.g. 1.0.0).
- `--include-prerelease`: Without --version, let the latest version be a pre-release (e.g. 1.2.3-beta).
- `--latest-version-resolution` SEMANTIC_VERSION|PUBLISH_TIME: Without --version, how the latest version is picked: SEMANTIC_VERSION (the highest version, the API's default) or PUBLISH_TIME (the most recently published, pre-releases included).
- beta · SDK: `functions.Query.execute`
